subject: [PATCH pynfs 1/6] server41tests: factor out sampling the server's clock

2026-11-18.patch_summary: This patch refactors code in the server41tests module to extract a new function, _server_now(), which samples the server's clock by creating and removing a scratch directory. This allows for easier reuse of this functionality in new delegated-timestamp tests. The original code has been simplified and reduced in size as a result.
